brief:
Hunter Biden sat down with journalist Mehdi Hasan for an hour-long conversation in Los Angeles, according to Zeteo. The discussion covered Gaza policy, Biden's personal struggle with addiction, and corruption allegations leveled against him. Biden also addressed his views on the Trump family and reflected on his father's unsuccessful 2024 reelection bid.

The wide-ranging interview touched on multiple contentious topics without apparent restraint during the in-person meeting. Biden discussed his regrets alongside his perspectives on Democratic politics and the presidential race. Hasan pressed the president's son on his legal troubles and personal recovery while examining his positions on foreign policy and the party's direction heading into the election cycle.
dek: In a no-holds-barred, hour-long, in-person conversation in LA, Biden also talks to Mehdi about his addiction, corruption allegations, the Trumps, and his father’s disastrous reelection campaign.
title: Mehdi Hasan interviews Hunter Biden on Gaza, addiction, and campaign
